notes: Official Yamaha Technical Data Sheet (Dec 2017). This is the YDIF-model variant (plain "XMV4140"); a Dante variant "XMV4140-D" exists with Dante primary/secondary etherCON-style RJ45 ports in place of/in addition to YDIF and is a separate SKU, not modeled here. Line Input is 2x 6-pin Euroblock connectors, each carrying 2 balanced channels (3 pins per channel: +, -, GND) — modeled here as 4 individual balanced line inputs to match per-channel port granularity. Speaker Output is 4 pairs of screw/barrier-strip terminals (channels A-D), modeled as euroblock (closest listed connector to a barrier/terminal strip; datasheet literally calls it "Barrier strip x 4 pairs," which is not in the allowed connector list). REMOTE and FAULT OUTPUT are two separate 3-pin Euroblock connectors per the Architectural & Engineering spec text (datasheet's compact table lists them together as "Euroblock (3P) x1" but the prose spec clarifies there are two). Network port confirmed as 100BASE-TX (fast ethernet) in the A&E spec text, hence eth-100m grade. YDIF RJ45 ports carry proprietary digital audio (16ch + word clock) over Cat5 — no standard Ethernet speed grade applies, so grade omitted (not an eth-XXX graded link). AC power inlet type (IEC C14) was not explicitly stated as "IEC" in the datasheet text (it only states universal 100-240V, 50/60Hz) but is inferred from the standard rear-panel photo/dimension drawing showing a standard IEC inlet, consistent with this Yamaha amplifier class; treat as medium-confidence for the connector subtype only.
